title: Dell RecoverPoint for Virtual Machines Hardcoded Credential Exploitation

steps.title: Use hardcoded credential for remote access
steps.text: Attacker uses the hardcoded credential (CVE-2026-22769) to access a network-reachable RecoverPoint for VMs appliance.
steps.description: Attacker uses the hardcoded credential (CVE-2026-22769) to access a network-reachable RecoverPoint for VMs appliance.

steps.title: Obtain operating-system access
steps.text: Attacker reaches the underlying OS and executes commands as a privileged user.
steps.description: Attacker reaches the underlying OS and executes commands as a privileged user.

steps.title: Establish root persistence
steps.text: Attacker establishes root-level persistence; GRIMBOLT/BRICKSTORM backdoors reported. (T1543 enabled only if local validation confirms service creation — behavioral.)
steps.description: Attacker establishes root-level persistence; GRIMBOLT/BRICKSTORM backdoors reported. (T1543 enabled only if local validation confirms service creation — behavioral.)

steps.title: Pivot toward VMware infrastructure
steps.text: Attacker uses remote services to move into connected VMware virtual infrastructure.
steps.description: Attacker uses remote services to move into connected VMware virtual infrastructure.

steps.title: Detect root access without maintenance ticket
steps.text: Blue team alerts on RecoverPoint access from an unapproved identity path and root sessions without a corresponding maintenance ticket.
steps.description: Blue team alerts on RecoverPoint access from an unapproved identity path and root sessions without a corresponding maintenance ticket.

steps.title: Contain and rebuild appliance
steps.text: SOC blocks untrusted access, applies the fixed release / remediation script, treats root access as an integrity failure and rebuilds as appropriate.
steps.description: SOC blocks untrusted access, applies the fixed release / remediation script, treats root access as an integrity failure and rebuilds as appropriate.
